resources.string: Big clock, date, a month calendar and, when music plays, a compact player — in the style of iPhone StandBy. Black OLED background with burn-in protection.
Automatically shows the clock while the phone charges in landscape (great on a stand). It never blocks your taps and hides itself on unplug, on rotation or from the notification.
The “display over other apps” permission is required.
Also use as the system screen saver
Android only auto-starts a screen saver when idle and charging on some devices. If yours does, pick “AlwaysON StandBy” as the screen saver in the settings it opens.
Waiting — will show while charging in landscape

There is no public Android API to draw while the screen is fully off (that is the manufacturer AOD). This app uses the closest supported options: the optional “while charging in landscape” overlay for phones like OnePlus that do not auto-start the built-in screen saver, and the system screen saver where the firmware honours it. The now-playing card only appears while music actually plays.
